Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Reflects the number of seconds past midnight that the Timestamp message was generated.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the system event was generated.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: System Event Codes

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates stock directory messages for all active symbols in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the directory message was generated. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the NASDAQ execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates Listing market or listing market tier for the issue

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: For NASDAQ-listed issues, this field indicates when a firm is not in compliance with NASDAQ continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if NASDAQ system limits order entry for issue

Field.Name: Issue Classification
Field.Description: Identifies the security class for the issue as assigned by NASDAQ. See Appendix for allowable values.

Field.Name: Issue Sub Type
Field.Description: Identifies the security sub-type for the issue as assigned by NASDAQ. See Appendix for allowable values.

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Denotes if an issue or quoting participant record is set-up in NASDAQ systems in a live/production, test, or demo state. Please note that firms should only show live issues and quoting participants on public quotation displays.

Field.Name: Short Sale Threshold Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is subject to mandatory close-out of short sales under SEC Rule 203(b)(3).

Field.Name: IPO Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the NASDAQ security is set up for IPO release. This field is intended to help NASDAQ market participant firms comply with FINRA Rule 5131(b).

Field.Name: LULD Reference Price Tier
Field.Description: Indicates which Limit Up / Limit Down price band calculation parameter is to be used for the instrument.

Field.Name: ETP Flag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the security is an exchange traded product (ETP):

Field.Name: ETP Leverage Factor
Field.Description: Tracks the integral relationship of the ETP to the underlying index. Example: If the underlying Index increases by a value of 1 and the ETP’s Leverage factor is 3, indicates the ETF will increase/decrease (see Inverse) by 3. Note: Leverage Factor of 1 indicates the ETP is NOT leveraged. This field is used for LULD Tier I price band calculation purposes.

Field.Name: Inverse Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the directional relationship between the ETP and underlying index. Example: An ETP Leverage Factor of 3 and an Inverse value of ‘Y’ indicates the ETP will decrease by a value of 3.

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the stock trading action message was generated

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the issue

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reflects the Market Ops or MarketWatch code for the trading state change.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Restriction Message
Message.Description: NASDAQ processes orders based on the most Reg SHO Restriction status value.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: NASDAQ internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the Reg SHO message was generated

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Stock symbol, right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination

Message.Name: Noii Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq disseminates NOII data at 5-second intervals in the minutes leading up to the Nasdaq Opening and Closing Crosses as well as the IPO/Halt Crosses

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the NOII message was generated

Field.Name: Paired Shares
Field.Description: Indicates the total number of shares that are eligible to be matched at the Current Reference Price.

Field.Name: Imbalance Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares not paired at the Current Reference Price.

Field.Name: Imbalance Direction
Field.Description: Indicates the market side of the imbalance

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for which the NOII message is being generated

Field.Name: Far Price
Field.Description: A hypothetical auction-clearing price for cross orders only.

Field.Name: Near Price
Field.Description: A hypothetical auction-clearing price for cross orders as well as continuous orders.

Field.Name: Current Reference Price
Field.Description: Indicates price at which the NOII shares are being calculated.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: Denotes the type of Nasdaq cross for which the NOII message is being generated

Field.Name: Price Variation Indicator
Field.Description: This field indicates the absolute value of the percentage of deviation of the Near Indicative Clearing Price to the nearest Current Reference Price.

Message.Name: Cross Trade Message
Message.Description: Cross Trade message indicates that Nasdaq has completed its cross process for a specific security. Nasdaq sends out a Cross Trade message for all active issues in the system following the Opening, Closing and EMC cross events. Firms may use the Cross Trade message to determine when the cross for each security has been completed.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the stock trading action message was generated

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: The number of shares matched in the Nasdaq Cross.

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: The security symbol associated with the cross trade message.

Field.Name: Cross Price
Field.Description: The price at which the cross occurred. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes.

Field.Name: Match Number
Field.Description: The Nasdaq generated day-unique Match Number of this execution.

Field.Name: Cross Type
Field.Description: The Nasdaq cross session for which the message is being generated.

Message.Name: IPO Quoting Period Update Message
Message.Description: Indicates the anticipated IPO quotation release time of a security.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time at which the IPO message was generated

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: IPO Quotation Release Time
Field.Description: Denotes the IPO release time for quotation to the nearest second. Format: HHMMSS

Field.Name: IPO Quotation Release Qualifier
Field.Description: IPO Quotation Release Qualifier Code

Field.Name: IPO Price
Field.Description: Denotes the IPO price to be used for intraday net change calculations.

Value.Name: Start of Messages
Value.Description: Start of Messages. This is always the first message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Start of System hours
Value.Description: This message indicates that NASDAQ is open and ready to start accepting orders.

Value.Name: Start of Market hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are available for execution.

Value.Name: Clear NOII - Opening Cross Data
Value.Description: Clear NOII - Opening Cross Data. This message signals that firms may clear NOII cache for the regular Opening Cross.

Value.Name: End of Market hours
Value.Description: This message is intended to indicate that Market Hours orders are no longer available for execution.

Value.Name: End of System hours
Value.Description: It indicates that Nasdaq is now closed and will not accept any new orders.

Value.Name: End of Messages
Value.Description: This is always the last message sent in any trading day.

Value.Name: Creations and Redemptions Suspended
Value.Description: Creations and/or Redemptions Suspended for Exchange Traded Product

Value.Name: Normal
Value.Description: Issuer Is NOT Deficient, Delinquent, or Bankrupt

Value.Name: NA
Value.Description: Not available. Firms should refer to SIAC feeds for code if needed.

Value.Name: Round Lots Only
Value.Description: NASDAQ system only accepts round lots orders for this security.

Value.Name: No Restrictions
Value.Description: NASDAQ system does not have any order size restrictions for this security. Odd and mixed lot orders are allowed.

Value.Name: restricted
Value.Description: Issue is restricted under SEC Rule 203(b)(3)

Value.Name: Set up For Ipo Release
Value.Description: NASDAQ listed instrument is set up as a new IPO security

Value.Name: Not Set up For Ipo Release
Value.Description: NASDAQ listed instrument is not set up as a new IPO security

Value.Name: Tier 1
Value.Description: Tier 1 NMS Stocks and select ETPs

Value.Name: Not Inverse ETP
Value.Description: ETP is not an Inverse ETP

Value.Name: Halted
Value.Description: Halted across all U.S. equity markets / SROs

Value.Name: Paused
Value.Description: Paused across all U.S. equity markets / SROs (NASDAQ-listed securities only)

Value.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction in effect due to an intra-day price drop in security

Value.Name: Test Restriction remains
Value.Description: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction remains in effect

Value.Name: Cross halted or paused
Value.Description: Intra-day Opening Cross for IPO and Halted/Paused securities
